# Psalm 124 — Disagreement Log

## 124:2 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** If-not YHWH who-was for-us, when-rose against-us men,
- **LOGOS:** if it had not been the LORD who was on our side when people rose up against us,
- **PNEUMA:** If the LORD had not been on our side when people attacked us,
